Engineering Manager

About the role: we are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our product squads. Responsibilities: you will grow engineers, set technical direction, and ship outcomes. Requirements: several years of engineering plus people-leadership experience. Qualifications: you balance delivery, quality, and team health. What you'll do: turn a group of engineers into a high-trust team. What we offer: competitive compensation, equity, and remote flexibility. Minimum qualifications: a track record of growing teams.
